_comment: The two symlink claims ported from `host/test/symlink.test.ts` when that file retired with the TypeScript filesystem. Both mutations are behaviours a filesystem can plausibly have -- one erases the link's type, the other makes `unlink` follow a final symlink, which would delete the file an alias points at.
verify: scripts/dev-shell.sh cargo test -q -p runtime-core --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" -- symlink >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: a symlink reports itself as an ordinary file, so a broken alias looks like a file
unlink follows a final symlink, so deleting an alias deletes what it points at
